<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex14022025-03-31-25" status="finalized" part="M" next="ex14022024-10-21-15-34"> gzhi shes kyi <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> la gsum las ¦ <milestone n="1. rtog pas btags pa dgag pa" unit="section"/>
rtog pas btags pa dgag pa ni | nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang gnyen po gzhi shes kyi <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3886">se</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs><note type="editorial">"Se" is understood to refer to be the author's teacher dge bshes Se dmar ba (ID:3886), but it could also be Jo bo Se btsun (ID:6763). "'Bre" is understood to refer to 'Bre shes rab 'bar (ID:3807) but could also refer to gTsang pa 'bre sgur (ID:3872). Stoltz argues in favor of the former (Stoltz 2022 [4LWBNM7B]: 121)</note></note> gzhi <expan>thams cad</expan> gang zag gi bdag med dang | gang zag gi bdag dang gzung ba rang bzhin med <lb edRef="inst:4574" n="24b3"/> pa tsam dang bdag mtha' dag skye ba med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'o zhes so |</seg></TEI>
